topics.description: Medicaid fraud is trending due to a recent case in Minnesota where a woman was accused of using $600K in Medicaid funds for personal expenses. This highlights the need for increased oversight and monitoring of Medicaid funds to prevent such abuses.

COVID fraud scheme is trending due to a recent conviction of a non-profit leader who pilfered $250M meant for underserved children. This highlights the need for increased vigilance and monitoring of COVID-related funds to prevent such abuses.
